meta_cites_federal_law_008.answer: The Elementary and Secondary Education Act (No Child Left Behind Act of 2001) (NCLB) now requires that all school districts employ only “highly qualified” teachers, as defined by the Act. The Elementary and Secondary Education Act also imposes additional specific “quality” requirements on elementary and secondary teachers.
